recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Ziti
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 1 pound boneless (skinless chicken breasts, cut into ½-inch strips)
¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional; or reduce to 1/8 teaspoon if sensitive to spice)
1 1/2 cups nonfat milk (plus additional as needed)
6 ounces dry whole wheat ziti pasta or similar pasta (such as penne, rigatoni, or fusilli (about 2 1/4 cups))
1  medium head broccoli (cut into florets (about 3 cups))
1  14 ounce can artichoke hearts in water (drained, cut into quarters, and patted dry)
2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice (for even more lemon flavor, add the zest also)
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese (plus additional for serving)
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley (plus additional for serving)
recipes.description: This creamy Chicken Broccoli Ziti cooks in one pan for easy clean up. Ready in 30 minutes! This healthy pasta recipe is lighter but doesn't skimp on flavor.

recipes.title: One Pan Chicken with Sweet Potatoes Kale and Cranberries
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 2  medium sweet potatoes (scrubbed, peeled, and cut into 1/2-inch dice)
1  large bunch kale (stemmed and roughly chopped (about 8 cups))
1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme or rosemary**
1/4 cup dried cranberries or fresh pomegranate seeds
Prepared brown and wild rice blend, brown rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice
recipes.description: An easy, healthy chicken dinner with sweet potatoes, kale, cranberries, and goat cheese. Ready in 30 minutes and filled with the best flavors of the season!
